metadata.description: A collection of agent skills for Claude

plugins.name: survey-mode
plugins.description: Listen-and-digest mode: Claude only listens, digests, and marks key points during free writing / brain dumps — no advice, no solutions, no converging — until the user calls stop, then delivers an integrated digest board.

plugins.name: swiss-slide-style
plugins.description: Swiss-minimal slide spec with a red (#C00000) + blue (#1912F7) dual-accent semantic system, large-type exec variant, Gantt and wording rules for upward reporting decks.
